_meta.label: EXPLORATORY (EDGE_CASE_POLICY §K). Offline re-aggregation, 0 model calls, 0 new trials.

definitions.route_intention: the route (A|B|HOLD) a role's own output commits to acting on this round
free_text_only_roles: researcher (no route field in SCHEMAS, falsify/org.py:20)
reviewer (no route field in SCHEMAS, falsify/org.py:22)
definitions.aggregation_rule: plurality over route intentions; ties -> HOLD (critiques/loop1_design.md §4)

disagreement_comparison.note: legacy flags 7.5% of rounds; route-intention disagreement is 0.0%. Every legacy-True round is a CONTINUE/REPLAN token difference with a unanimous route intention (confirms critiques/exp001_pilot_skeptic.md §1.4).

sensitivity_to_unrecoverable_intentions.method: adversarial: every unrecoverable role-round assigned the worst-case route (A/B/HOLD), all combinations enumerated
sensitivity_to_unrecoverable_intentions.structured_only_fallback: dropping both free-text roles entirely leaves planner vs executor, which agree in 80/80 rounds; no tie, no difference

clustering_caveat.note: the 80 rounds are nested in 20 trials and are not independent: within a trial nothing changes between rounds, so a trial is effectively one route decision repeated ~4x. Rates are reported at both levels.

findings.headline: 0/80 multi-agent rounds differ between plurality(tie->HOLD) and planner authority; 0/80 route-intention disagreement; 0/80 ties; 20/20 action sequences identical. Rate is exactly 0/80.
findings.legacy_vs_route_intention: legacy disagreement 6/80 = 0.075 vs route-intention 0/80 = 0.000; absolute gap 0.075 (7.5 percentage points). All 6 legacy-True rounds are unanimous on route.
findings.measurement_validity_finding: 2 of 4 roles (researcher, reviewer) have NO route field in their output schema (falsify/org.py SCHEMAS lines 20-23), so their route intention is never structurally recorded. 146/160 free-text role-rounds could be adjudicated from text; 14/160 (8.75%) could not and were left as null rather than imputed. This is a measurement-validity limitation, not a zero.
findings.policy_F_audit: no round record in data/trials/exp001_pilot.jsonl carries the executor_overridden field; that field postdates this run. Executor compliance (20/20 trials, 80/80 rounds) is confirmed by recomputation (planner plan_route maps to executor action in 80/80), not by a logged override flag. The policy-F override path is therefore unexercised and untested on this data.
findings.exploratory_label: EXPLORATORY per EDGE_CASE_POLICY §K. No hypothesis status change is proposed by this analysis.
